blocks.text: **Questions do not reveal Truth, the Holy Spirit reveals Truth.**
_John introduces fellowship here as a concept to be experienced with GOD_
Study questions by section
Why do you think John says “Word of life” here instead of simply saying “Jesus”?
What does John seem to mean by calling Jesus “the eternal life” who was with the Father?
What do these verses show us about where real joy comes from?
What do you think it means to “walk in darkness”?
Can a believer drift into darkness, and if so, what does that look like?
How does hidden sin affect fellowship in the Body of Christ?
Read [[Matthew 5:23-24]]. How does this help us think about our relationship with God and our relationships with one another?
Why do you think people are tempted to minimize or deny their sin?
What stands out to you about the pattern of denial, confession, and denial again in verses 8-10?
How is confession different from simply feeling guilty?
What do these verses show us about what happens when we refuse to be honest about our sin?
Key synthesis
Hidden sin keeps us in darkness, confession brings us into the light, reconciliation repairs fellowship, and unity in the Body becomes the visible fruit of walking with God in truth

How does receiving God’s forgiveness change the way we show grace, compassion, and forgiveness to each other in the Body of Christ? ([1 John 1:9](https://route.bible/?q=1%20John%201%3A9&utm_source=chatgpt&utm_medium=prompt), [Ephesians 4:32](https://route.bible/?q=Ephesians%204%3A32&utm_source=chatgpt&utm_medium=prompt), [Colossians 3:12-13](https://route.bible/?q=Colossians%203%3A12-13&utm_source=chatgpt&utm_medium=prompt)).
